<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/nodes/{nodeId}/operational-profile"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Appends a profile revision; earlier revisions are never edited. Called by vendor-connectivity (declaredBy VENDOR) and by the network-ops planner (declaredBy NETWORK_OPS). Every day of a cutoff must fall inside the operating hours of that day, and a revision of an ACTIVE FULFILLMENT_CENTER keeps at least one cutoff and a handlingTime above zero. sortDwellMinutes is accepted only for SORTATION_CENTER and AIR_HUB nodes. The optional inbound limits (maxCartonWeightG, maxCartonDimsMm, acceptsPallets, requiresSscc) are declared per revision; a revision without inbound declares none, and consumers then treat inbound limits as unchecked. Only node types with the INBOUND capability (FULFILLMENT_CENTER, INBOUND_CROSS_DOCK) declare inbound limits; any other type is 422 inbound-limits-not-allowed. Publishes NodeOperationalProfileDeclared.
